## Create Seurat Objects for each sample
### save Seurat objects as individual RDS files

``` {r}
# set file paths
input.path <- "counts/pediatric_cancer/"
md <- read.csv("data/meta/scpca_meta.csv", row.names = 1)

dir.create("output/scPCA/objects")
```

``` {r}
# Create seurat objects function
create_sobj <- function(name) {
  print(paste0("Running sample: ", name, "."))
  # define paths
  output.path <- paste("output/scPCA/objectsindividual", name, sep = "/")
  dir <- paste(input.path, name, "outs", sep = "/")
  mat.path <- paste(dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix", sep = "/")
  
  # read data
  data <- Read10X(mat.path)
  
  # Create Seurat object
  sobj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = data,
    assay = 'RNA',
    project = 'pediatric_cancer_atlas'
  )
  sample <- md[md$run == name,]
  for (col in names(sample)) {
    sobj@meta.data[,col] <- sample[,col][[1]]
  }

  # Save RDS of seurat object
  output <- paste(output.path, ".RDS", sep = "")
  saveRDS(object= sobj, file = output)
  
  print("RDS saved.")
  return(sobj)

}

```


```{r}
sobj.list <- lapply(samples, create_sobj)
sobj.list<- Filter(Negate(is.null), sobj.list)
saveRDS(sobj.list, file = "output/scPCA/objects/sobj.list.RDS")
print("All saved.")
```


## Cell Cycle Scoring
```{r}
# A list of cell cycle markers, from Tirosh et al, 2015, is loaded with Seurat.  We can
# segregate this list into markers of G2/M phase and markers of S phase
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes

```

```{r}
sobj.list <- lapply(sobj.list, function(sobj) {
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "RNA"
  sobj <- NormalizeData(sobj)
  sobj <- CellCycleScoring(sobj, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes)
  sobj$CC.Difference <- sobj$S.Score - sobj$G2M.Score
  return(sobj)
})
```

```{r}
saveRDS(sobj.list, "output/scPCA/sobj.listCCS.RDS")
sobj.merged <- merge(sobj.list[[1]], sobj.list[2:length(sobj.list)])
saveRDS(sobj.merged, "output/scPCA/sobj.merged.RDS")
```

## Quality control Plots (individual)

```{r}
# Create Seurat object list split by sample (not by run)
sobj.merged <- JoinLayers(sobj.merged)
sobj.list <- SplitObject(sobj.merged, split.by = "sample_id")
samples <- names(lapply(sobj.list, function(sobj){sobj$sample_id[[1]]}))
names(sobj.list) <- samples
```


```{r}
sobj_qc <-function(sobj) {
  
  # Takes in list of samples and generate quality control plots for each sample.
  # store mitochondrial percentage in object meta data
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "RNA"
  sobj <- PercentageFeatureSet(sobj, pattern = "MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")
  name <- sobj$sample_id[1]
  
  # Create Violin plot
  Vln.name <- paste("output/scPCA/objectsplots/QC", name, "violin_plot.pdf",  sep = "/")
  ggsave(filename = Vln.name, 
         plot = VlnPlot(
           object = sobj,
           features = c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA","percent.mt", "CC.Difference", "S.Score", "G2M.Score"),
           pt.size = 0.1,
           ncol = 3,
         ),
         units = "in",
         height = 10,
         width = 12,
         create.dir = T
  )
  
  ##############################################################################
  # pre-processing and dimensional reduction on both assays independently, 
  # using standard approaches for RNA and ATAC-seq data.
  
  # RNA analysis
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "RNA"
  sobj <- sobj %>%
    SCTransform(vst.flavor = 'v2') %>% # note: in Seurat v4, ‘v1’ is the default, in v5, ‘v2’ is default
    RunPCA(reduction.name = "pca", reduction.key = "PCArna_") %>%
    RunUMAP(reduction="pca", reduction.name = "umap.rna", reduction.key = "UMAPrna_", dims = 1:30) %>%
    FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30)
  
  # test cluster resolution
  sobj <- FindClusters(sobj, resolution=0.5)
  DimPlot(sobj, label = TRUE)
  
  # Find markers using RNA assay
  # find markers for every cluster compared to all remaining cells
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "RNA"
  markers.rna <- FindAllMarkers(sobj, only.pos = TRUE)
  head(markers.rna)
  
  # Find variable features
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "RNA"
  sobj <- FindVariableFeatures(sobj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
  # plot variable features 
  LabelPoints(VariableFeaturePlot(sobj), points = head(VariableFeatures(sobj), 10), repel = TRUE)
  VarFeat.name <- paste("output/scPCA/plots/QC", name, "VariableFeatures.pdf",  sep = "/")
  ggsave(VarFeat.name, 
         plot = LabelPoints(VariableFeaturePlot(sobj), points = head(VariableFeatures(sobj), 10), repel = TRUE),
         units = "in",
         height = 8.5,
         width = 11)
  # Feature plot with QC metrics
  metrics <- c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA","percent.mt", "CC.Difference", "S.Score", "G2M.Score")
  sobj_copy <- sobj
  FeaturePlot(sobj_copy, 
              features = metrics,
              pt.size = 0.4,
              label = TRUE,
              reduction = "umap.rna"
  )
  
  metric_featplot.name <- paste("output/scPCA/plots/QC", name, "metrics_features.pdf",  sep = "/")
  ggsave(metric_featplot.name, 
         plot =   FeaturePlot(sobj_copy, 
                              features = metrics,
                              pt.size = 0.4,
                              label = TRUE),
         units = "in",
         height = 8.5,
         width = 11)
  
  
  # Script to assign markers
  
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "SCT"
  DimPlot(sobj, reduction = "umap.rna", 
          group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, label.size = 2.5, repel = TRUE) + ggtitle("RNA_UMAP")
  rna_umap.name <- paste("output/scPCA/plots/QC", name, "RNA_UMAP.pdf",  sep = "/")
  ggsave(rna_umap.name, 
         plot = DimPlot(sobj, reduction = "umap.rna", 
                        group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, label.size = 2.5, repel = TRUE) + ggtitle("RNA_UMAP"),
         units = "in",
         height = 8.5,
         width = 11)
  
  #top10 genes
  # markers.sobj <- markers.rna
  # markers.sobj %>%
  #   group_by(cluster) %>%
  #   dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 1) %>%
  #   slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  #   ungroup() -> top10
  # DoHeatmap(sobj, features = top10$gene) + NoLegend()
  # top10.name <- paste("/igm/projects/HD-BAT_Wedemeyer/output/scPCA/objectsplots/QC", name, "top10Heatmap.pdf", sep = "/")
  # ggsave(top10.name,
  #        plot = DoHeatmap(sobj, features = top10$gene) + NoLegend(),
  #        units = "in",
  #        width = 28,
  #        height = 13)
  
  
  # markers.rna %>%     
  #   group_by(cluster) %>%
  #   slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  #   ungroup() -> top
  # rna.list <- lapply(levels(sobj), function(cluster) {
  #   cluster.markers <- markers.rna[which(markers.rna$cluster==cluster),"gene"]
  # })
  # names(rna.list) <- paste0("cluster", 0:(length(unique(sobj$seurat_clusters)) - 1))
  return(sobj)
}
```

```{r}

sobj.list <- lapply(sobj.list, sobj_qc)
names(sobj.list) <- samples
saveRDS(sobj.list, "output/scPCA/objects/sobj.list.qc.RDS")

```

## Scrublet

First, we create a directory full of the features (genes) tab separated value files.
```{bash}
# make genes folder
mkdir data/counts/pediatric_cancer/genes

for d in data/counts/pediatric_cancer/*; 
  do 
    name="${d:60:11}"
    gunzip -c data/counts/pediatric_cancer/"$name"/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz  > data/counts/pediatric_cancer/genes/"$name"_features.tsv
  done
```

Then we run scrublet in python before running the script (code/scrub.py).
```{bash}
# run scrublet
# samples.csv is a column of sample names
sample_dir="output/scPCA/samples.csv"
input_dir="data/counts/pediatric_cancer/"
output_dir="output/scPCA/objects/scrub/"
gene_dir="data/counts/pediatric_cancer/genes/"

python scrub.py "$sample_dir" "$input_dir" "$output_dir" "$gene_dir"
```

Back to R to add doublet score to metadata.
```{r}
sobj <- readRDS("output/scPCA/objects/sobj.merged.qc.RDS")
# Get doublet scores
sobj@meta.data$doublet_score <- "0"
for (sample in unique(sobj$run)) {
  pscrub <- read_table(paste0("scrub/", sample, "_doublet_scores.txt"),col_names = F)
  
  sobj@meta.data[sobj@meta.data$run == sample, "doublet_score"] <- pscrub$X1
}
sobj@meta.data$Predicted_Doublets <- ifelse(sobj$doublet_score > 0.25, "Doublet","Singlet" )
table(sobj@meta.data$Predicted_Doublets)
```
## QC Cutoff

```{r}
# Assign QC cutoffs and subset
sobj2<-sobj
sobj2 <- subset(sobj2,
                subset =
                  nFeature_RNA < 5000 &
                  nCount_RNA < 30000 &
                  Predicted_Doublets == "Singlet")
# See how mant cells remain
print(paste0("Number of cells before QC: ", dim(sobj)[2], "."))
print(paste0("Number of cells after QC: ", dim(sobj2)[2], "."))

```

``` {r}
# save qc'd object
saveRDS(sobj2, "output/scPCA/objectsobjects/cancer.qc.RDS")
sobj <- sobj2
rm(sobj2)
```

```{r}
    RunPCA(reduction.name = "pca", reduction.key = "PCArna_") %>%
    RunUMAP(reduction="pca", reduction.name = "umap.rna", reduction.key = "UMAPrna_", dims = 1:30) %>%
    FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30)
  
  # test cluster resolution

  DimPlot(sobj, label = TRUE)
  
  # Find markers using RNA assay

  markers.rna <- FindAllMarkers(sobj, only.pos = TRUE)
  head(markers.rna)
  
  # Find variable features
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "RNA"
  sobj <- FindVariableFeatures(sobj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
  # plot variable features

  # Feature plot with QC metrics
  metrics <- c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA","percent.mt", "CC.Difference", "S.Score", "G2M.Score")
  sobj_copy <- sobj
  FeaturePlot(sobj_copy, 
              features = metrics,
              pt.size = 0.4,
              label = TRUE,
              reduction = "umap.rna"
  )
  
  metric_featplot.name <- paste("objects/JL12/plots/QC", name, "metrics_features.pdf",  sep = "/")
  ggsave(metric_featplot.name,

                              features = metrics,

  DimPlot(sobj, reduction = "umap.rna",

  rna_umap.name <- paste("objects/JL12/plots/QC", name, "RNA_UMAP.pdf",  sep = "/")
```

# MS

```{r}
# create list of sample names
samples <- list.dirs(path = "data/counts/MS", 
                     full.names = F, 
                     recursive = F)
samples <- samples[1:(length(samples)-1)]
```

## Create Seurat Objects for each sample
### save Seurat objects as individual RDS files

```{r}
# set file paths
input.path <- "data/counts/MS"
md <- read.csv("data/ms_meta.csv", row.names = 1)

md<-md[,c("Sample.Name","AGE", "lesion", "source_name")]
names(md) <- c("sample_id", "age", "lesion", "tissue")

md <- unique(md)
rownames(md) <- md$sample_id

```

```{r}
sobj.list <- lapply(samples, function(name) {
  output.path <- paste("output/MS/objects/individual", name, sep = "/")
  dir <- paste(input.path, name, "outs", sep = "/")
  mat.path <- paste(dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix", sep = "/")
  data <- Read10X(mat.path)
  # Create Seurat object
  sobj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = data,
    assay = 'RNA',
    project = 'MS'
  )
  # add metadata
  sample <- md[name,]
  for (col in names(sample)) {
    sobj@meta.data[,col] <- sample[,col][[1]]
  }
  
  # Save RDS of seurat object
  output <- paste(output.path, ".RDS", sep = "")
  saveRDS(object= sobj, file = output)
  
  message("RDS saved.")
  return(sobj)
})
```

```{r}
names(sobj.list) <-samples
saveRDS(sobj.list, file = "output/MS/objects/sobj.list.RDS")
```

```{r}
sobj_qc <-function(sobj,out) {
  
  # Takes in list of samples and generate quality control plots for each sample.
  # store mitochondrial percentage in object meta data
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "RNA"
  sobj <- PercentageFeatureSet(sobj, pattern = "MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")
  name <- sobj$sample_id[1]
  
  # Create Violin plot
  Vln.name <- paste(out, name, "violin_plot.pdf",  sep = "/")
  ggsave(filename = Vln.name, 
         plot = VlnPlot(
           object = sobj,
           features = c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA","percent.mt", "CC.Difference", "S.Score", "G2M.Score"),
           pt.size = 0.1,
           ncol = 3,
         ),
         units = "in",
         height = 10,
         width = 12,
         create.dir = T
  )
  
  ##############################################################################
  # pre-processing and dimensional reduction on both assays independently, 
  # using standard approaches for RNA and ATAC-seq data.
  
  # RNA analysis
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "RNA"
  sobj <- sobj %>%
    SCTransform(vst.flavor = 'v2') %>% # note: in Seurat v4, ‘v1’ is the default, in v5, ‘v2’ is default
    RunPCA(reduction.name = "pca", reduction.key = "PCArna_") %>%
    RunUMAP(reduction="pca", reduction.name = "umap.rna", reduction.key = "UMAPrna_", dims = 1:30) %>%
    FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30)
  
  # test cluster resolution
  sobj <- FindClusters(sobj, resolution=0.5)
  DimPlot(sobj, label = TRUE)
  
  # Find markers using RNA assay
  # find markers for every cluster compared to all remaining cells
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "RNA"
  markers.rna <- FindAllMarkers(sobj, only.pos = TRUE)
  head(markers.rna)
  
  # Find variable features
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "RNA"
  sobj <- FindVariableFeatures(sobj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
  # plot variable features 
  LabelPoints(VariableFeaturePlot(sobj), points = head(VariableFeatures(sobj), 10), repel = TRUE)
  VarFeat.name <- paste(out, name, "VariableFeatures.pdf",  sep = "/")
  ggsave(VarFeat.name, 
         plot = LabelPoints(VariableFeaturePlot(sobj), points = head(VariableFeatures(sobj), 10), repel = TRUE),
         units = "in",
         height = 8.5,
         width = 11)
  # Feature plot with QC metrics
  metrics <- c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA","percent.mt", "CC.Difference", "S.Score", "G2M.Score")
  sobj_copy <- sobj
  FeaturePlot(sobj_copy, 
              features = metrics,
              pt.size = 0.4,
              label = TRUE,
              reduction = "umap.rna"
  )
  
  metric_featplot.name <- paste(out, name, "metrics_features.pdf",  sep = "/")
  ggsave(metric_featplot.name, 
         plot =   FeaturePlot(sobj_copy, 
                              features = metrics,
                              pt.size = 0.4,
                              label = TRUE),
         units = "in",
         height = 8.5,
         width = 11)
  
  
  # Script to assign markers
  
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "SCT"
  DimPlot(sobj, reduction = "umap.rna", 
          group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, label.size = 2.5, repel = TRUE) + ggtitle("RNA_UMAP")
  rna_umap.name <- paste(out, name, "RNA_UMAP.pdf",  sep = "/")
  ggsave(rna_umap.name, 
         plot = DimPlot(sobj, reduction = "umap.rna", 
                        group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, label.size = 2.5, repel = TRUE) + ggtitle("RNA_UMAP"),
         units = "in",
         height = 8.5,
         width = 11)
  
  #top10 genes
  # markers.sobj <- markers.rna
  # markers.sobj %>%
  #   group_by(cluster) %>%
  #   dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 1) %>%
  #   slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  #   ungroup() -> top10
  # DoHeatmap(sobj, features = top10$gene) + NoLegend()
  # top10.name <- paste(out, name, "top10Heatmap.pdf", sep = "/")
  # ggsave(top10.name,
  #        plot = DoHeatmap(sobj, features = top10$gene) + NoLegend(),
  #        units = "in",
  #        width = 28,
  #        height = 13)
  
  
  # markers.rna %>%     
  #   group_by(cluster) %>%
  #   slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  #   ungroup() -> top
  # rna.list <- lapply(levels(sobj), function(cluster) {
  #   cluster.markers <- markers.rna[which(markers.rna$cluster==cluster),"gene"]
  # })
  # names(rna.list) <- paste0("cluster", 0:(length(unique(sobj$seurat_clusters)) - 1))
  return(sobj)
}
```

First, we create a samples.csv.


```{r}
samples <- sobj$sample_id %>% unique()
data.frame(sample_names = samples) %>% write.csv(.,file = "output/scPCA/samples.csv")
```

## Scrublet

First, we create a directory full of the features (genes) tab separated value files.
```{bash}
# make genes folder
mkdir data/counts/MS/genes

for d in data/counts/MS/*; 
  do 
    gunzip -c data/counts/MS/"$name"/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz  > data/counts/MS/genes/"$name"_features.tsv
  done
```

Then we run scrublet in python before running the script (code/scrub.py).
```{bash}
# run scrublet
# samples.csv is a column of sample names
sample_dir="output/MS/samples.csv"
input_dir="data/counts/MS/"
output_dir="output/MS/objects/scrub/"
gene_dir="data/MS/pediatric_cancer/genes/"

python scrub.py "$sample_dir" "$input_dir" "$output_dir" "$gene_dir"
```

Back to R to add doublet score to metadata.
```{r}
# Get doublet scores
sobj@meta.data$doublet_score <- "0"
for (sample in samples) {
  pscrub <- read_table(paste0("scrub/", sample, "_doublet_scores.txt"),col_names = F)
  
  sobj@meta.data[sobj@meta.data$sample_id== sample, "doublet_score"] <- pscrub$X1
}
sobj@meta.data$Predicted_Doublets <- ifelse(sobj$doublet_score > 0.25, "Doublet","Singlet" )
table(sobj@meta.data$Predicted_Doublets)

saveRDS(sobj,"output/MS/objects/sobj.metrics.rds")
```

# Assign QC cutoffs and subset

```{r}
dim(sobj) # [1] 59462 55196
sobj <- subset(sobj,
               subset = 
                 nFeature_RNA < 6000 &
                 nCount_RNA < 30000 &
                 percent.mt < 20 &
                 Predicted_Doublets == "Singlet")
dim(sobj) # [1] 59462  52856
```

```{r}
# save file 
saveRDS(sobj,"objects/mapping/ms.rds")
```

# Dropseq (follow steps in https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-20892-3)
```{r}
# create list of sample names
dropseq.samples <- list.files(path = "data/counts/jh_dropseq/dropseq/") %>% 
  gsub(".dge.txt.gz", "", .) %>%
  gsub(".dge.summary.txt", "", .) %>% 
  unique()
```

## Create Seurat Objects for each sample
### save Seurat objects as individual RDS files

```{r}
# set file paths
input.path <- "data/counts/jh_dropseq/dropseq/"
md <- read.csv("data/meta/ds_meta.txt", row.names = 1)

md<-md[,c("Sample.Name","AGE", "cell_type", "source_name")]
names(md) <- c("sample_id", "age", "cell_type_orig", "source_name")
```

```{r}
dropseq.list <- lapply(dropseq.samples, function(name) {
  output.path <- paste("output/jh_dropseq/objects/individual", name, sep = "/")
  # get path
  mat.path <- paste0(input.path, name, ".dge.txt.gz")
  # get dge
  dge <- read.delim(file = mat.path, row.names = 1)
  # Create Seurat object
  sobj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = dge,
    assay = 'RNA',
    project = 'dropseq'
  )
  # add metadata
  sample <- md[name,]
  for (col in names(sample)) {
    sobj@meta.data[,col] <- sample[,col][[1]]
  }
  
  # Save RDS of seurat object
  output <- paste(output.path, ".RDS", sep = "")
  saveRDS(object= sobj, file = output)
  
  print("RDS saved.")
  return(sobj)
})
```
```{r}
names(dropseq.list) <- md$sample_id
saveRDS(dropseq.list, file = "output/jh_dropseq/objects/dropseq.list.RDS")
```

## Cell Cycle Scoring
```{r}
# A list of cell cycle markers, from Tirosh et al, 2015, is loaded with Seurat.  We can
# segregate this list into markers of G2/M phase and markers of S phase
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
```

```{r}
dropseq.list <- lapply(dropseq.list, function(sobj) {
  DefaultAssay(sobj) <- "RNA"
  sobj <- NormalizeData(sobj)
  sobj <- CellCycleScoring(sobj, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes)
  sobj$CC.Difference <- sobj$S.Score - sobj$G2M.Score
  return(sobj)
})
```

```{r}
saveRDS(dropseq.list, "output/jh_dropseq/objects/dropseq.listCCS.RDS")
dropseq.merged <- merge(dropseq.list[[1]], dropseq.list[2:length(dropseq.list)])
dropseq.merged <- JoinLayers(dropseq.merged)
saveRDS(dropseq.merged, "output/jh_dropseq/objects/dropseq.merged.RDS")
```

```{r}

                     full.names = F, 
                     recursive = F)
```

## Create Seurat Objects for each sample
### save Seurat objects as individual RDS files

```{r}
# set file paths
input.path <- "data/counts/jh_dropseq/cellranger"
md <- read.csv("data/meta/ds_meta10X.txt", row.names = 1)

md<-md[,c("Sample.Name","AGE", "cell_type", "source_name")]
names(md) <- c("sample_id", "age", "cell_type_orig", "source_name")
rownames(md) <- samples[c(2,1)]
```

```{r}
cellranger.list <- lapply(cellranger.samples, function(name) {
  output.path <- paste("objects/individual", name, sep = "/")
  dir <- paste(input.path, name, "outs", sep = "/")
  mat.path <- paste(dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix", sep = "/")
  data <- Read10X(mat.path)
  # Create Seurat object
  sobj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = data,
    assay = 'RNA',
    project = 'cellranger'
  )
  # add metadata
  sample <- md[name,]
  for (col in names(sample)) {
    sobj@meta.data[,col] <- sample[,col][[1]]
  }
  
  # Save RDS of seurat object
  output <- paste(output.path, ".RDS", sep = "")
  saveRDS(object= sobj, file = output)
  
  print("RDS saved.")
  return(sobj)
})
```

```{r}
cellranger@meta.data$doublet_score <- "0"
cellranger@meta.data$sample_id %>% unique()
cellranger$sample_name <- ifelse(cellranger@meta.data$sample_id == "GSM4983787", yes = "d85_OPC", no= "iPSC")
for (sample in cellranger.samples) {
  pscrub <- read_table(paste0("scrub/", sample, "_doublet_scores.txt"),col_names = F)
  
  cellranger@meta.data[cellranger@meta.data$sample_name == sample, "doublet_score"] <- pscrub$X1
}
cellranger@meta.data$Predicted_Doublets <- ifelse(cellranger$doublet_score > 0.25, "Doublet","Singlet" )
table(cellranger@meta.data$Predicted_Doublets)

saveRDS(cellranger,"objects/merged/cellranger.metrics.rds")
```

# Assign QC cutoffs and subset

## Dropseq

```{r}
dim(dropseq) # [1] 22088   900
dropseq <- subset(dropseq,
               subset = 
                 nFeature_RNA < 5000 &
                 nCount_RNA < 30000 &
                 percent.mt < 20)
dim(dropseq) # [1] 22088   882
```

## 10X Genomics single cell
```{r}
dim(cellranger) # [1] 59462  9002
cellranger <- subset(cellranger,
               subset = 
                 nFeature_RNA < 6000 &
                 nCount_RNA < 30000 &
                 percent.mt < 20 &
                 Predicted_Doublets == "Singlet")
dim(cellranger) # [1] 59462  8073
```

```{r}
jh_dropseq <- merge(dropseq,cellranger)
jh_dropseq <- JoinLayers(jh_dropseq)
saveRDS(jh_dropseq, "output/jh_dropseq/objects/sobj.merged.qc.RDS")
```
